name: Accounts Executive
description:
Experience : 2 to 4 years

Department: Finance & Accounting

Job Summary:

We are seeking an accurate, organized, and detail-oriented Account Executive (AP & AR) to oversee our daily financial transactions and ledger operations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounts Payable (Bills Payable)

• Invoice Processing: Verify, code, and enter vendor invoices, bills, and expense reports into the accounting system with accuracy..

• Three-Way Matching: Match purchase orders (POs), receiving documents, and vendor invoices to resolve price or quantity discrepancies..

• Payment Execution: Prepare and execute timely weekly/monthly payment runs via checks, ACH, wire transfers, or credit cards, ensuring available early-payment discounts are utilized..

2. Accounts Receivable (Bills Receivable)

• Invoicing: Generate and issue accurate, timely invoices and credit memos to clients based on sales orders, contracts, or billing schedules..

• Payment Application: Receive, verify, and post incoming customer payments (checks, electronic transfers, credit cards) against corresponding invoices..

• Dispute Resolution: Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies or customer payment issues efficiently..

3. Reconciliation & General Ledger

• Bank Reconciliation: Perform regular bank and credit card reconciliations to ensure ledger balances align with bank statements..

• Ledger Maintenance: Maintain accurate sub-ledgers for AP and AR and assist with general ledger postings and month-end journal entries..

Qualifications & Skills

Education & Experience:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline..

• Experience: 2–4 years of hands-on experience handling Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and bank reconciliations.

name: GKE Engineer

location.name: Gurugram, Bangalore, Indore, Raipur, Chennai, IN

locations.name: Gurugram, Bangalore, Indore, Raipur, Chennai, IN

description:
Core Responsibilities:

  • Enterprise Cluster Orchestration: Lead the deployment and lifecycle management of production GKE clusters. You will manage node pool configurations, version upgrades, and multi-zonal availability.
  • Advanced CI/CD Automation: Architect and maintain sophisticated deployment pipelines for microservices using ArgoCD (GitOps) and GitHub Actions, ensuring a 'push-to-deploy' developer experience.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Drive a 100% automation mandate by provisioning and managing all GCP resources using Terraform.
  • Optimization & Observability: Implement proactive monitoring and fine-tune cluster performance. You will be responsible for cost-optimization through strategic autoscaling (HPA/VPA) and right-sizing.
  • Security Governance: Establish a Zero Trust framework within the cluster by configuring granular IAM roles, service account least-privilege access, and FQDN-based network policies.
  • Kubernetes Tooling & Extensibility: Act as the subject matter expert for Helm, managing complex manifest updates, Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs), and Kubernetes Operators.

    • Technical Requirements:

    • Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), with a heavy focus on Kubernetes.
    • Platform Expertise: Deep architectural knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and GKE.
    • Deployment Tools: Proven track record of implementing GitOps workflows using ArgoCD and automating workflows with GitHub Actions.
    • IaC Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Terraform for managing complex cloud environments.
    • Packaging & CLI: Advanced experience modifying Helm charts, managing CRDs, and using the Kubernetes CLI (kubectl) for deep-dive troubleshooting.
    • Networking & Security: Solid understanding of Kubernetes networking, including Ingress controllers, Load Balancers, and FQDN network policies.

    Why Join Us?

    • Work in an innovative environment with the business that is shaping the future of data migration.
    • Be part of a dynamic, high-growth environment at NucleusTeq.
    • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
